name: SignaturePad
label: Signature pad
description: A signature drawn with a pointer or typed, kept as SVG with a PNG on demand.

props.name: label
props.description: Label text above the pad.

props.name: mode
props.description: `draw` takes a drawn signature, `type` a typed name, `both` lets the reader choose. Defaults to `both`, since typing is the way in for anyone who cannot draw with a pointer.

props.name: value
props.description: The signature (controlled). A drawn one cannot be loaded back for editing: pass `null` to clear the pad, or keep the value the pad last handed over.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The typed name the pad starts with (uncontrolled), which also starts it on the type tab.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the signature after each stroke, each change to the typed name, and each clear (with `null`).

props.name: height
props.description: The pad's height: `default`, or `tall` for a wider hand or a touch screen.

props.name: size
props.description: Component size

props.name: disabled
props.description: Whether the pad is disabled

props.name: error
props.description: Error state without a message of its own.

props.name: errorText
props.description: The error message under the pad; setting it marks the pad invalid.

props.name: helperText
props.description: Helper text below the pad.

props.name: required
props.description: Marks the pad required.

props.name: name
props.description: The form field name: the form receives the signature's SVG through a hidden input.

props.name: placeholderLabel
props.description: Text on the baseline before anything is drawn. Defaults to "Sign here".

props.name: padLabel
props.description: The drawing surface's accessible name. Defaults to "Signature drawing area".

props.name: modeLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the draw and type choice. Defaults to "Signature method".

props.name: drawLabel
props.description: The draw tab's text. Defaults to "Draw".

props.name: typeLabel
props.description: The type tab's text. Defaults to "Type".

props.name: nameLabel
props.description: The typed name's field label. Defaults to "Type your full name".

props.name: clearLabel
props.description: The clear button's text. Defaults to "Clear".

props.name: undoLabel
props.description: The undo button's text. Defaults to "Undo".

props.name: addedLabel
props.description: Announced politely after a stroke is drawn. Defaults to "Signature added".

props.name: clearedLabel
props.description: Announced politely after the pad is cleared. Defaults to "Signature cleared".

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS classes
